item.title: Qwen3-Coder-Next
item.description: Qwen3-Coder-Next is built for self-hosted coding agents — an 80B-total, 3B-active mixture-of-experts model under an Apache 2.0 license, small enough to run on a single well-equipped workstation instead of a data-center cluster.
